thought.text: Ini pertanyaan teknis soal recovery akun Google, dan ada tautan FB yang mau saya cek. Saya lihat dulu tautannya, sambil menyiapkan analisis.

action.command: curl -sL --max-time 30 -A "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/120.0 Safari/537.36" "https://www.facebook.com/share/1FGZmmvDsi/" -o /tmp/fb.html -w "HTTP %{http_code} size=%{size_download}\n"; grep -oiE '<title>[^<]*</title>|og:description" content="[^"]{0,300}' /tmp/fb.html | head -5

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "curl -sL --max-time 30 -A \"Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/120.0 Safari/537.36\" \"https://www.facebook.com/share/1FGZmmvDsi/\" -o /tmp/fb.html -w \"HTTP %{http_code} size=%{size_download}\\n\"; grep -oiE '<title>[^<]*</title>|og:description\" content=\"[^\"]{0,300}' /tmp/fb.html | head -5", "summary": "Fetch the Facebook share link", "security_risk": "LOW", "timeout": 60}
